sections.title: UPPER GREAT LAKES TO SRN PLAINS/MID MS VALLEY
sections.text: EARLY MORNING SATELLITE AND RADAR IMAGERY SUGGEST A FAIRLY WELL DEFINED MID LEVEL VORT IS LOCATED ALONG THE SD/NEB BORDER JUST NORTH OF VTN...MOVING ESEWD AT ROUGHLY 20-25KT IN LINE WITH LATEST SHORT RANGE MODEL GUIDANCE. GIVEN THIS SPEED IT APPEARS A MID AFTERNOON POSITION OVER CNTRL IA CAN BE EXPECTED...WITH A SHORTWAVE TROUGH EXTENDING ACROSS SERN KS. ALL SHORT RANGE GUIDANCE STRONGLY SUGGESTS A CORRIDOR OF SEASONABLY STRONG MID LEVEL FLOW WILL STRETCH FROM THE CNTRL ROCKIES...ACROSS KS/MO INTO THE LOWER OH VALLEY. GFS/NAM/RUC ALL INDICATE 40-45KT 500MB SPEED MAX WILL EXTEND FROM SRN KS INTO SRN MO AT PEAK HEATING. AS THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH DIGS SEWD THE VERY MOIST TROPICAL AIRMASS IN PLACE OVER TX/LA/OK/AR WILL RETURN NWD PRIOR TO AFTERNOON CONVECTION. SEVERAL SMALL THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS ARE CURRENTLY ONGOING ACROSS THE SRN HIGH PLAINS...AND FROM ERN NEB INTO SRN MN. THIS ACTIVITY MAY NOT COMPLETELY DIE OFF BEFORE 12Z...ESPECIALLY OVER THE MID/UPPER MS VALLEY REGION. IN FACT AN MCS MAY BE ONGOING OVER THE MID MO VALLEY AT SUNRISE WITH SLOW UPWARD INTENSIFICATION POSSIBLE AS BOUNDARY LAYER WARMS AHEAD OF UPPER VORT MAX. HAIL AND ISOLATED SEVERE WIND GUSTS ARE POSSIBLE WITH THIS AC

sections.title: SERN U.S
sections.text: ROBUST THUNDERSTORMS MAY ONCE AGAIN DEVELOP ACROSS PARTS OF THE SERN U.S. SUNDAY AS CONVECTION DEVELOPS ALONG SRN FRINGE OF STRONGER MID LEVEL FLOW ACROSS GA/SC. ALTHOUGH MID LEVEL TEMPERATURES ARE NOT EXPECTED TO BE VERY COOL...H5 AROUND -5C...STEEP LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES MAY ENHANCE DOWNDRAFT POTENTIAL BENEATH STRONGER TSTM CORES. ACTIVITY SHOULD WEAKEN WITH LOSS OF DAYTIME HEATING. ..DARROW/GRAMS.. 07/11/2010

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER PARTS OF NEB/SD
sections.text: ...SYNOPSIS... A BAND OF MODERATE CYCLONIC FLOW WILL PREVAIL FROM THE NRN RCKYS/NRN HI PLNS ACROSS THE CNTRL PLNS/MID MS VLY TO THE MID ATLANTIC CST THIS PERIOD...S OF MORE HIGHLY-AMPLIFIED SHORTWAVE TROUGH CROSSING MB/WRN ONT. LEAD DISTURBANCE IN THE CYCLONIC FLOW...NOW OVER ERN NEB...SHOULD REACH WRN IL THIS EVE BEFORE CONTINUING ESE INTO IND EARLY MON. FARTHER W...SATELLITE AND OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS SHOW A PAIR OF IMPULSES OVER WRN MT AND SRN ID. THESE FEATURES MAY PARTLY PHASE...AND SHOULD REACH THE WRN DAKOTAS/CNTRL HI PLNS BY EVE. AT LWR LVLS...COLD FRONT ASSOCIATED WITH MB/ONT TROUGH SHOULD MOVE STEADILY S/SE ACROSS THE NRN PLNS/UPR MS VLY TODAY...WITH THE WRN PART BECOMING QSTNRY OVER ERN WY/WRN NEB BY EVE. FARTHER S...WEAK LOW NOW OVER NEB SHOULD REDEVELOP GENERALLY E/SE THROUGH THE DAY...WHILE DIFFUSE WARM FRONT EXTENDING SEWD FROM THE LOW REFORMS NEWD INTO MO.

sections.title: ERN KS INTO MID MS/LWR OH/LWR TN VLYS AND NRN OK/AR
sections.text: TAIL END OF LOOSELY-ORGANIZED MCS ASSOCIATED WITH NEB/IA UPR TROUGH IS OVER NERN KS ATTM. SOME INTENSIFICATION OF THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD OCCUR LATER THIS MORNING AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER WARMS OVER ERN KS...AND AS STORMS ENCOUNTER LEADING EDGE OF MORE SUBSTANTIAL MOISTURE /PW AOA 1.75 INCHES/ NOW SPREADING N FROM OK. HAIL AND ISOLD DMGG WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE. CONVECTIVE COVERAGE/SVR THREAT SHOULD FURTHER INCREASE THIS AFTN OVER ERN KS/WRN MO IN RESPONSE TO CONTINUED LOW LVL DESTABILIZATION AND TO ASCENT PROVIDED BY SRN FRINGE OF UPR TROUGH. WHILE LOW LVL WINDS WILL REMAIN WEAK...PRESENCE OF SUBSTANTIAL INSTABILITY /SBCAPE AOA 3000 J PER KG/...INCREASINGLY RICH MOISTURE...AND VERTICALLY-VEERING WIND PROFILES MAY SUPPORT A FEW HP SUPERCELLS. DURING THEIR EARLIER STAGES OF DEVELOPMENT...THESE COULD YIELD A TORNADO OR TWO...IN ADDITION TO SVR HAIL/WIND. THE STORMS SHOULD MERGE INTO A LARGE CLUSTER BY EARLY EVE. WIND AND THERMODYNAMIC CONSIDERATIONS SUGGEST THAT THIS MCS SHOULD MOVE GENERALLY SSE INTO OK/AR...WHILE TENDING TO BACK-BUILD WWD ACROSS OK. THE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM MAY POSE A THREAT FOR DMGG WIND/MARGINALLY SVR HAIL THROUGH LATE TONIGHT. A BIT FARTHER N AND E...SUSTAINED ASCENT

sections.title: ERN WY INTO WRN/CNTRL SD/NEB LATE AFTN/EVE
sections.text: HIGH-BASED TSTMS SHOULD FROM THIS AFTN OVER ERN/NRN WY AND PERHAPS SRN MT...IN ZONE OF WEAK UPSLOPE FLOW AND ASCENT AHEAD OF MT/ID UPR IMPULSE. MOISTURE WILL BE COMPARATIVELY LIMITED. BUT COMBINATION OF STEEP LOW TO MID LVL LAPSE RATES...MODERATE UNIDIRECTIONAL WNWLY CLOUD LAYER FLOW...AND CONTINUED ESE MOTION OF UPR TROUGH SUGGEST THAT ACTIVITY MAY SUFFICIENTLY INCREASE IN COVERAGE/STRENGTH TO POSE A THREAT FOR SVR HAIL/WIND AS THE STORMS MOVE/DEVELOP ESE INTO PARTS OF NEB/SD. THE STORMS MAY MERGE INTO ONE OR TWO SMALL CLUSTERS THIS EVE. EMBEDDED FORWARD-PROPAGATING SEGMENTS MAY POSE A THREAT FOR LOCALLY DMGG WIND THROUGH LATE EVE AS THE ACTIVITY ENCOUNTERS MORE SUBSTANTIAL MOISTURE AND DEVELOPING RETURN FLOW OVER CNTRL NEB.

sections.title: SERN U.S
sections.text: SCTD STRONG DIURNAL STORMS MAY ONCE AGAIN FORM OVER PARTS OF THE SERN U.S. TODAY IN ZONE OF HIGH PW ALONG SRN EDGE OF STRONGER WNWLY UPR FLOW. MID LVL TEMPERATURES WILL BE RELATIVELY WARM /AROUND -5C AT 500 MB/. BUT STEEP LOW LVL LAPSE RATES MAY ENHANCE DOWNDRAFT POTENTIAL AND FOSTER A FEW MARGINALLY SVR WIND GUSTS GIVEN HIGH PW. ..CORFIDI/ROGERS.. 07/11/2010

sections.title: IA INTO THE UPPER MIDWEST
sections.text: THE COMBINED EFFECTS OF MID VALLEY SHORT WAVE TROUGH AND LARGER-SCALE TROUGH DIGGING SEWD THROUGH MANITOBA/ONTARIO INTO THE UPPER GREAT LAKES WILL PROVIDE FAVORABLE BACKGROUND FORCING FOR ASCENT FOR TSTM DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT. THE PRIMARY UNCERTAINTY IS THE DEGREE OF AIR MASS DESTABILIZATION AHEAD OF SEWD-MOVING COLD FRONT GIVEN THE WIDESPREAD CLOUD COVER. 12Z MODEL GUIDANCE SUGGESTS THAT POCKETS OF STRONGER HEATING WILL COMBINE WITH A RELATIVE MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER /I.E. DEWPOINTS IN THE 60S/ TO SUPPORT AREAS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY LATER TODAY. AS SUCH...THE THREAT WILL EXIST FOR STRONG TO SEVERE TSTM DEVELOPMENT ALONG THE FRONT OVER MN/WI...AS WELL AS IN ADVANCE OF PRONOUNCED CYCLONIC CIRCULATION /PER RADAR IMAGERY/ PROGRESSING EWD THROUGH CNTRL IA. VERTICAL SHEAR WILL REMAIN SOMEWHAT MARGINAL FOR ORGANIZED/SUSTAINED STORMS...THOUGH A THREAT FOR HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL EXIST IN AREAS WHERE STRONGER DESTABILIZATION CAN OCCUR.

sections.title: ERN WY INTO SD/NEB
sections.text: 12Z 500 MB ANALYSIS AND CURRENT WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SUGGEST THE PRESENCE OF ONE /OR PERHAPS MULTIPLE/ SHORT WAVE TROUGH/S/ EMBEDDED WITHIN WNWLY FLOW REGIME OVER THE NRN INTERMOUNTAIN REGION INTO NRN HIGH PLAINS. WHEN COUPLED WITH A STEEP LAPSE RATE ENVIRONMENT AND RESIDUAL BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE IN THE WAKE OF FRONTAL PASSAGE...SETUP WILL FAVOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF A FEW SEWD-MOVING SEVERE STORMS CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL.

sections.title: SERN ATLANTIC COAST
sections.text: THE PRESENCE OF A HOT...HUMID AND MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS ALONG WITH A WEAK FRONTAL BOUNDARY SHOULD SUPPORT THE DEVELOPMENT OF NUMEROUS TSTMS THROUGH THE DIURNAL HEATING CYCLE. 12Z FFC SOUNDING SHOWED THE PRESENCE OF SLIGHTLY STRONGER WLY FLOW /I.E. 25-30 KT/ IN THE 3-6 KM AGL LAYER. THIS COMBINED WITH THE MODERATE INSTABILITY MAY PROMOTE THE ORGANIZATION OF A FEW STORM CLUSTERS WITH THE MAIN THREAT FOR WET MICROBURSTS/DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. ..MEAD/GARNER.. 07/11/2010

sections.title: SRN MO/AR EWD TO WRN KY/WRN TN/FAR NRN MS/FAR NRN AL
sections.text: A PROGRESSIVE SHORTWAVE TROUGH...CURRENTLY LOCATED OVER THE MIDWEST/MID MS VALLEY...IS EXPECTED TO MOVE INTO THE OH VALLEY BY 12Z MONDAY. BAND OF 40-50 KT WNWLY MIDLEVEL WINDS ALONG SRN PERIPHERY OF THIS MID-UPPER LEVEL TROUGH WILL TRANSLATE EWD FROM CURRENT POSITION /KS TO MO BOOTHEEL/...REACHING KY/TN BY END OF THE FORECAST PERIOD. EARLY EVENING SURFACE ANALYSIS SHOWED AN AREA OF LOW PRESSURE OVER ERN KS WITH A BOUNDARY EXTENDING SEWD THROUGH SWRN MO TO WRN TN. FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDANT TO SRN EXTENT OF MID MS VALLEY TROUGH AND WAA ALONG NOSE OF SWLY LLJ EXTENDING INTO SERN EXTENDING BOUNDARY SUGGEST TSTMS WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP OVERNIGHT. GIVEN RESIDUAL MODERATE INSTABILITY ALONG AND S/SW OF THE BOUNDARY EXTENDING SEWD INTO THE MID SOUTH AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR 40-45 KT...ORGANIZED STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS REMAIN LIKELY AFTER DARK WITH POTENTIAL FOR AN MCS SPREADING SSEWD INTO AR/MID SOUTH OVERNIGHT AS LLJ VEERS TO WLY.

sections.title: SERN KS INTO NRN/CENTRAL OK
sections.text: RESIDUAL MODERATE-STRONG INSTABILITY FROM OK INTO THE SRN TX PANHANDLE SUGGESTS ONGOING TSTM CLUSTERS SHOULD BE MAINTAINED THROUGH THE EVENING...WITH ISOLATED STRONG WIND GUSTS AND HAIL THE PRIMARY THREATS. ACTIVITY SHOULD SHIFT SLOWLY SWD INTO SLY LOW LEVEL FLOW. HOWEVER...WEAK EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR WITH SRN EXTENT WOULD SUGGEST THAT OVERALL SEVERE WEATHER THREAT SHOULD DIMINISH AS ACTIVITY MOVES FARTHER SWD.

sections.title: SRN SD/NEB
sections.text: MIDLEVEL IMPULSE TRACKING ESEWD ALONG NRN NEB/SRN SD BORDER ATTM PER WATER VAPOR IMAGERY WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT TSTM DEVELOPMENT OVER CENTRAL NEB. MODERATE INSTABILITY AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR UP TO 50 KT WILL RESULT IN ADDITIONAL SUPERCELLS WITH AN ATTENDANT THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL...SOME VERY LARGE OVER CENTRAL/ERN PARTS OF WW 457 WHERE STEEP LAPSE RATES AND STRONGEST INSTABILITY WILL SUPPORT THIS THREAT. MODELS SUGGEST ADDITIONAL TSTMS CURRENTLY LOCATED OVER ERN WY/NERN CO AND SWRN SD COULD DEVELOP/SPREAD E/SEWD INTO MAINLY WRN/CENTRAL NEB OVERNIGHT AS HEIGHTS FALL IN ADVANCE OF AN UPPER TROUGH MOVING THROUGH THE NRN HIGH PLAINS. IN ADDITION...LOW LEVEL WINDS OVER THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS SHOULD BECOME SLY AND STRENGTHEN FROM WRN KS INTO WRN NEB RESULTING IN AN INCREASING WAA REGIME INTO THE WRN HALF OF NEB LATER TONIGHT/EARLY MONDAY MORNING. ..PETERS.. 07/12/2010
